$comment: THE LABEL OF AN UNNAMED GROUP, WRITTEN ONCE AND ASSERTED ON BOTH IMPLEMENTATIONS.
Owner, 2026-11-17: a group created without a name stores none, and EVERY device draws it by its
other members' first names - in the app (`composeUnnamedGroupLabel`, unnamedGroupLabel.ts) and,
since 2026-11-27, on a push raised while the app is dead (Rust `compose_unnamed_group_label`,
src-tauri/src/mobile/unnamed_group_label.rs, the ONE native copy: the Android FCM service and the
iOS extension both call it). The web cannot run the Rust and a dead app cannot run the WebView, so
the RULE is shared as data: a case added here fails in both at once.
THE RULE. The members are user ids (the group's ratchet tree, one per person), compared ASCII-
lower-cased; the viewer and duplicates are dropped. Each is named by `names[id]` trimmed - the
caller's resolution (a nickname set in the group, else the profile's first name, else its name) -
or by its id when that is empty. The ORDER is fixed, never the device's locale: first by the
collation key (Unicode NFD, every combining mark (General_Category M) removed, then lower-cased),
compared code point by code point; then by the name itself, code point by code point; then by the
id. One name reads alone; two and three are joined by the language's 'and'; past three, two are
named and the rest counted, so the count is never one. Nobody else in the group: null, and the
`fr` and `en` are the label in each language, words from messages/{fr,en}.json
group: no name stored, the members' first names drawn'.

cases.name: names the other members, never the viewer
compares the viewer and the members ASCII-lower-cased
the order is the names', never the tree's
an accent does not move a name at the first level
case does not move a name at the first level
two names equal at the first level are ordered by the names themselves
a hyphen sorts before a letter
a member with no name is named by their id
past three, two are named and the rest counted
the count says how many more
the viewer alone has no label
an empty tree has no label
